concept: Portraits at a timber yard gateway
creativeDirection: Daylight location photography in a real outdoor timber yard uses stacked logs and cut wood as a physically plausible setting, carrying the two sleeve portraits into the scene intact while turning the woodcut motif into monumental timber forms.
scene: A wide 16:9 editorial photograph in an open timber yard under hard midday sun, viewed straight on at slightly below eye level so stacked log ends fill the background like a graphic wall while a clear central aisle opens into the distance.

elements.element: the woman from reference image 1 appears chest-up and front-facing exactly as in her studio portrait, with long straight platinum-blonde hair, the small yellow hair clip, neutral expression, and glossy black jacket with red and white lightning patches

the man from reference image 2 appears in his close-up dramatic pose with one arm raised, hand gripping his black leather jacket collar, shadowed face, stubble, and dangling cross earring, staged intact within the yard

large cut log ends form oversized tree-ring discs, one especially prominent with a centered opening or painted inset revealing a narrow forest path motif, while smaller flowers and leaves appear growing along one side of the timber stack as a subtle echo of the woodcut decoration

coverSummaries.description: A studio portrait of one woman shown from the chest up against a pale grey background. She faces forward with a neutral expression, long straight platinum-blonde hair parted near the middle, and a small yellow hair clip on one side. She wears a glossy black jacket with bold red and white lightning-like patches over a dark top with a hint of purple visible at the neckline. The composition is tightly cropped around her face and upper torso.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: long straight platinum-blonde hair with a small yellow hair clip
coverSummaries.people: one woman facing forward in a close-up studio portrait

coverSummaries.description: A tightly cropped color photograph of one man in a dramatic pose, mostly in shadow, wearing a black leather jacket. One arm is raised over his head while the other hand grips the jacket collar near his face. His face is partly obscured, with visible stubble and a dangling cross-shaped earring on one ear. The background is a flat blue field, and the image emphasizes glossy leather texture, skin highlights, and strong contrast.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: dangling cross earring beside a shadowed face and black leather jacket
coverSummaries.people: one man in a close-up pose with raised arm, leather jacket, and cross earring

coverSummaries.description: A black-and-white illustrated image centered on an oval cross-section of a tree trunk or wood slice. Inside the rings is a small forest scene with tall trees and a path receding into the distance. The outer wood grain forms swirling concentric shapes around the inner scene, and a cluster of flowers and leaves appears along the left edge. The composition sits on a plain white background with strong contrast and fine carved linework.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: tree-ring cross-section enclosing a forest path

prompt: A wide 16:9 editorial location photograph in a real open timber yard, shot straight on from slightly below eye level, with stacked cut logs forming a strong graphic backdrop and a central aisle receding into the distance. Primary subject: the woman from reference image 1 and the man from reference image 2 staged as the key figures in front of the log stacks, each appearing only once and keeping their original sleeve portrait poses, framing, expression, hair, styling, and gaze intact. The woman from reference image 1 is shown chest-up and front-facing with long straight platinum-blonde hair parted near the middle, the small yellow hair clip, neutral expression, and glossy black jacket with bold red and white lightning-like patches over a dark top with a hint of purple. The man from reference image 2 is shown in his tight dramatic pose with one arm raised over his head, the other hand gripping the black leather jacket collar near his face, visible stubble, partly shadowed face, and dangling cross-shaped earring, set against a clean blue-painted panel or blue sky pocket within the yard so his source color field is preserved. Use source 3 by making the yard dominated by large circular log ends with crisp concentric tree rings; feature one especially prominent cut trunk cross-section near center or just off-center that reveals a narrow forest path motif within it as a real carved or inset opening, and add a restrained cluster of flowers and leaves along the left side of the timber stack echoing the woodcut embellishment. Daylight location photography, physically plausible and sharply detailed, with clean editorial realism and no collage look. Compose with a clear hierarchy: the two portraits foremost, the monumental tree rings second, the forest-path timber motif as the visual surprise in the middle distance. Hard midday sun with crisp shadows, high clarity, saturated but natural color, clean blacks, bright wood surfaces, pale greys and blue accents, confident graphic mood. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 1 shows one woman facing forward in a close-up studio portrait; reference image 2 shows one man in a close-up pose with raised arm, leather jacket, and cross earring. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image brightly and cleanly: open, readable shadows and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
